integrity: Symbolic proof supplied with direct independent-code finite enumerations for small fields and dimensions. Self-review only; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete normal form concerns weight one over a characteristic-two field and the exact chain multiplication; the q-count requires q a power of two. No statement is made about arbitrary higher-step perturbations, other characteristics, or operator schemes. An older equivalent classification might exist.
title: Characteristic-two Frobenius normal forms for weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on chain evolution algebras
